parsed.strategy: I only hold names with a dated event inside Oct 12-Nov 13, 2026, spread across semis (ASML Oct 14, TSM Oct 15, TER Oct 27, Hon Hai Oct 30), biotech PDUFAs (MRK Oct 10, AGIO Nov 1, SMMT Nov 14), defense (Saab/Kongsberg Oct 23-29, Rheinmetall/Hensoldt Nov 5), gambling (Evolution Oct 23, Aristocrat Nov 12), nuclear (Cameco Nov 3) and pharma (Novo Nov 4). No single day carries more than two names. I would be wrong if a macro shock or a broad AI-capex digestion headline hits the semis cluster at once, or if several PDUFAs return CRLs, since rejection moves are 2-4x larger than approval pops.
